decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the products provided, I filtered for actual backpacks rather than camping accessories or miscategorized items. The QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out as the strongest option due to its exceptionally high rating of 4.7 across over 6,000 reviews, indicating high durability and customer satisfaction. Compared to the more expensive Mardingtop hiking pack or the specialized Transpack skate bag, the QT&QY offers the best versatility and value for its price point of $39.99.
